sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD  AND  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TYAGARAJA N. INAVALLY  -3-  NC: 2025:KHC-K:7504-DB  MFA No. 200342 of 2024 HC-KAR  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD)

This appeal is filed under section 37(1)(c) of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (for short, 'the Act') challenging the judgment and award dated 30.09.2021 passed by the IV Additional District Judge, Vijayapura in Arbitration Application No.33/2020, whereby the award passed by respondent No.3, Arbitrator-cum-Deputy Commissioner has been confirmed by dismissing the application.
2.
Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the land of the appellant was acquired by the National Highway Authority of India.
Pursuant to which, the award was passed on 06.09.2013.

Aggrieved by the quantum of compensation awarded by the competent authority, the appellant has sought for re-determination and enhancement by invoking Sections 3(G)(5) and (6) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7504-DB HC-KAR 3.

The Arbitral Tribunal comprising of a sole Arbitrator appointed by the Central Government having entrusted into reference proceeded to pass the impugned arbitral award on 23.01.2020 re-determining and enhancing the market value of the subject land belonging to the appellant.
However, not being satisfied by the amount so determined by the Arbitrator, the appellant approached the jurisdictional Court under Section 34 of Act.
By the impugned judgment and order dated 30.09.2021, the Trial Court proceeded to dismiss the said application filed by the appellant.
Being aggrieved by the same, the appellant is before this Court.

4. The main contention raised by the learned counsel for the appellant is that the impugned judgment and order passed by the Trial Court is not only contrary to the provisions contained in Section 34 of the Act, but the same is also contrary to the decision of the Apex Court in case of Union of India and Another Vs. Tarsem Singh NC: 2025:KHC-K:7504-DB HC-KAR and Others [AIR 2019 SC 4689].

entities.text: Union of India and Another Vs. Tarsem Singh NC: 2025:KHC-K:7504-DB HC-KAR and Others [AIR 2019 SC 4689]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He also contended in respect of quantum of compensation awarded.
5. Be that as it may, now the question is that the Apex Court in case of Tarsem Singh (supra) struck down Section 3J of the National Highways Act, 1956.

On the similar lines, considering this aspect of Sharaschandra vs The Assistant Commissioner / Competent ... on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116356392/
3 the issue in MFA No.200229/2022, this Court allowed the appeal vide its judgment dated 21.02.2022 by setting aside the judgment and order passed by the Arbitral Tribunal and remitted the matter back to the Deputy Commissioner for fresh re-consideration.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6. In view of the above, we pass following:
ORDER i.
The appeal is hereby allowed.

ii. The impugned judgment and order dated 30.09.2021 passed by the IV Additional District Judge, Vijayapura, in Arbitration Application No.33/2020 and the Arbitral award dated 23.01.2020 passed by respondent NC: 2025:KHC-K:7504-DB HC-KAR No.3/Arbitrator- cum- Deputy Commissioner, are set aside.

iii. Matter is remitted back to respondent No.3- Arbitrator-cum-Deputy Commissioner for re- consideration afresh, in accordance with law, bearing in mind the observations made in this order,
within a period of six months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
iv. All rival contentions of the partiers are kept open.
v. This Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.

vi. In view of the order dated 05.12.2025 passed by this Court, in case respondent No.3 enhances the compensation, the claimant is not entitled for interest on the enhanced compensation for the delayed period of 537 days in filing the appeal.

Sd/-
(H.T.NARENDRA PRASAD) JUDGE Sd/-
(TYAGARAJA N. INAVALLY) JUDGE DM List No.: 1 Sl No.: 12 Sharaschandra vs The Assistant Commissioner / Competent ...
